Analysis

Netto-Verschuldungsgrad

A measure of financial leverage calculated as total debt minus cash and cash equivalents, divided by EBITDA or another performance metric; reflects the company’s effective indebtedness after netting liquid assets.

Definition

A measure of financial leverage calculated as total debt minus cash and cash equivalents, divided by EBITDA or another performance metric; reflects the company’s effective indebtedness after netting liquid assets.

Operational example

Net leverage is closely monitored by rating agencies and creditors, as it accounts for the impact of available cash on the company’s overall debt profile.

Localized term

Netto-Verschuldungsgrad

Localized example
